title: Grateful Dead Live at Cincinnati Gardens on 1973-12-04
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude v7.02 Professional -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of the rare Dec 4 1973 Cincinnati Gardens show delivers a solid mix and a spectacular 'Eyes of the World' jam, but overall it feels like an average 1973 performance.
ai_review.review: The Miller‑86839 SBD provides a clear, well‑balanced capture that many reviewers rate highly, though a few note tuning edits and a brief missing segment. Musically the concert shines on the extended 'Eyes of the World' → 'Sugar Magnolia' sequence and tight renditions of 'Me & My Uncle' and 'Big River', while the rest of the set drifts into typical early‑’73 average territory.

ai_rating.rationale: Two reviewers give strong positive marks for both performance and mix, while a third rates the show as merely average; overall rating falls in the good‑to‑great range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, well‑balanced sound noted by one reviewer; other notes mention standard SBD tuning edits and a brief missing section around 8:30, but no major muffling or dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unique setlist opening with 'Johnny B. Goode' and a late start pushed the second set short; the concert features a strong jam‑heavy middle (Eyes → Sugar Magnolia) surrounded by typical early‑’73 material.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar weaves colorful solos throughout the extended 'Eyes of the World' jam, adding inventive flair.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil dominates the 'Eyes' segment, steering the band with powerful bass lines and dynamic improvisation.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's keyboard work is praised as solid, keeping the groove steady even when other parts wobble.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey briefly drops out during the long improv before re‑engaging, creating a momentary ebb in the rhythm.
